title: Brooms, brushes, hand-operated mechanical floor sweepers (not motorized), mops and feather dusters; prepared knots and tufts for broom or brush making; paint pads and rollers; squeegees (other than roller squeegees)

author_provenance.detail: The author produced an exact four-file artifact and could not open the worktree Git index lock. The controller recorded the verified bytes in the named Git checkpoint as distinct provenance.

review.class_rule: Complete manual mops are expressly covered. The scope fixes a cut-end cotton yarn head bound to a wooden handle by wire, received as constituent materials and assembled through first complete-mop quality release. Powered equipment, replacement heads, separate inputs and unrelated 38993 merchandise are excluded.
review.unit_basis: Measured net 1 kg of first-released complete dry mops at stated conditioning. The separate original-cohort service ledger uses its own measured release denominator. Physical and environmental accounts are distinct and normalized once.
review.allocation: Dedicated stages then subdivision and exchange-specific physical causality; residual market allocation only for evidenced common-gate actual coproducts. Reconciled physical flow remains independent.
review.translation: English and Chinese agree on scope, first release, gross physical balance, original cohort, provider ownership, allocation and unresolved reference status. Status remains aligned.
review.range_limit: Unverified quantities remain site-specific collection requirements; no unsupported amount ranges were adopted.
review.native_limit: Mass/Units of mass/kg support verified from the public historical ILCD source. Concrete product and unverified exchanges retain unresolved identities.

evidence_sources.role: Manufacturer construction evidence; listed dimensions and use preparation do not set the reference.
Separate equipment provider supports generic cotton mop-yarn cutting, with no demonstrated link to the representative factory.
Public archived native ILCD mass support; exact file hashes in manifest.

delivery_gate: Full npm run validate is required on the exact integration snapshot.
